manifest.name: dsh-plugin-selection-comments
manifest.description: Selection comments and a side chat window for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: annotate model output with floating comments, and open selected text in an independent conversation.
manifest.author: AaronOhO

bundle.text:
# Selection comments bundle layer: inserts the Host half that carries the
# browser plugin. All behaviour lives in the Client module; the Host half is
# an inert loader row.
- insert:
    - id: selection-comments
      name: dsh-plugin-selection-comments

readme.text:
A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin that brings **ChatGPT-desktop-style selection
comments** and an **independent side conversation window** to the Harness chat.

一个把 **ChatGPT 桌面端的划词评论** 和 **独立悬浮会话窗口** 带到 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的插件。

| | |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |
| 选中模型输出后的快捷操作栏 / quick-action toolbar | 悬浮评论框 / anchored comment editor |
|  |  |
| 注释列表（编辑 / 删除 / 全部删除）/ annotation list | 独立会话窗口 / independent conversation window |

More: [saved highlights + chip](docs/screenshots/03-chip-and-markers.png),
[list row actions](docs/screenshots/05-comment-list-actions.png),
[dark window](docs/screenshots/07-side-window-dark.png),
[dark chip](docs/screenshots/08-chip-dark.png),
[plugin settings row](docs/screenshots/09-plugin-settings.png),
[annotations pending above the composer](docs/screenshots/10-annotations-pending.png),
[annotations sent as message content](docs/screenshots/11-annotation-sent.png).

- 选中模型输出（assistant 输出）里的任意文字，浮出快捷操作栏：**添加到对话** / **更多详情**。
- 点击「添加到对话」在选区旁浮出评论框：引用所选文字，可写可选评论（可空），`Cmd/Ctrl + Enter` 或发送按钮确认。
- 确认后：
  - 所选文字被持久高亮为蓝色，并在范围末尾显示带编号的橙色标记；
  - 底部输入框上方出现 `N 条注释` 胶囊按钮。
- 点击胶囊 → 悬浮注释列表（编号 + 所选文本 + 用户评论 + 编辑 / 删除），列表可滚动。
- 每条注释支持**修改**（回到评论框并预填）与**删除**；胶囊上的 `×` 一次删除本会话全部注释。
- 注释按会话保存在浏览器本地（localStorage），刷新页面后高亮、编号、胶囊都会恢复。
- **注释会随下一条用户消息一起发给模型**：发送时会把「所选文本 + 用户评论」作为引用块放进该条消息（会话里可见），发送成功后注释自动清空（高亮、编号、胶囊一起消失），文字已经进入对话历史。
- **只有注释、输入框为空时也能发送**：输入框为空且有注释时，右侧 ↑ 会恢复为正常的蓝色可点击样式（宿主原本把它禁用成半透明），点 ↑、点「发送注释」、或直接按 `Enter` 都能把注释作为单独一条消息发出。

- 在选中文字后点击「更多详情」，打开一个悬浮的独立会话窗口（`更多详情`）。
- 该窗口里的会话是当前会话在最近一个已完成轮次上的 **fork**：上下文完整，但和主会话完全独立，主会话不会被它改动。
- 窗口有自己的输入框与发送/停止按钮，可拖动标题栏移动、拖动右下角缩放、收起/展开、关闭。
- 该独立会话**不会出现在侧边栏**：插件按会话 id 隐藏其侧边栏行（`[data-row-key="session:<id>"]`），并记住隐藏列表。
- 用同一段选中的文字再次点「更多详情」会复用同一个独立会话，不会重复 fork。

- 主题跟随 Harness（浅色 / 深色），只使用 `--dsw-*` 主题 token。
- 支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`，键盘可达（`Esc` 关闭浮层，`Cmd/Ctrl+Enter` 保存评论）。
- 所有 UI 通过 Harness 的 Slot 注册（`shell.overlay`、`conversation.input.dock`）与 React 渲染，不注入 iframe、不替换应用根节点。

The plugin is a standard DSH bundle: a package manifest with a bundle patch plus
a browser Client half.

```sh

dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-selection-comments
```

Or install straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add AaronOhO/dsh-plugin-selection-comments
```

Or install the directory from **Settings → Plugins → 添加插件 / install bundle** in the
Harness Plugin Manager (point it at this directory). Enable the 「划词评论与独立会话」
row, then reload the page once so the Client bundle is loaded.sh

The script backs up `package.json` next to itself and only appends the linked
dependency + bundle selection; removing either (or toggling the bundle off in
Plugin Manager after a restart) uninstalls the plugin.

本插件是标准 DSH bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`）。可通过
`dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本目录>`，或在 **设置 → 插件 → 安装 bundle**
中选择本目录；启用「划词评论与独立会话」后刷新一次页面。

readme.text:
> The plugin needs no Host configuration and no model/API changes. Removing it
> removes both floating surfaces and the sidebar-row hiding rule; the comments
> stay in browser storage unless cleared.

| Part | File | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host half | `index.js` | Inert loader row; all behaviour is browser-side. |
| Bundle patch | `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `selection-comments` row. |
| Client module | `client.js` | The built browser bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`), generated from `src/` by `build.mjs`. |
| Source modules | `src/*.js` | Store, persistence, annotation data, text anchoring + CSS highlights, comment surfaces, side-chat window, slot registrations. |
| Shared contract | [`docs/CONTRACT.md`](docs/CONTRACT.md) | State shape, data/action APIs, integration points, verification checklist. |
| Styles | `src/styles/*.css` | Base surfaces plus comment/side-chat refinements, built into the single client bundle. |
| Display metadata | `locale/zh.json`, `locale/en.json`, `icon.svg` | Titles, descriptions and icon shown by the Plugin Manager. |

- **Selection** is captured from the rendered transcript with the exact quote,
  row anchor key (`data-chat-anchor-key`), text offsets, and surrounding context.
  Only assistant output rows are eligible.
- **Highlights** use the CSS Custom Highlight API (`::highlight(...)`), so React
  re-renders never erase them; ranges are re-anchored by quote + context after
  streaming settlement or history reload.
- **Comments** live in `localStorage` (`dsh-selection-comments:v1:*`) per session
  and never touch the session log.
- **The independent window** hosts a real embedded Conversation occurrence for a
  forked session through the shared `conversation.content` Factory and
  `SessionProvider`, so it reuses the host's chat/composer exactly.
- **Sidebar hiding** keeps the fork out of navigation without touching session
  data; the persisted hidden list re-applies the rule on every page load.

Independent end-to-end verification report (43/43 checks, light + dark, reload
persistence): [`docs/verification/REPORT.md`](docs/verification/REPORT.md)
(machine-readable [`report.json`](docs/verification/report.json)).

Automated verification uses the bundled isolated Harness runtime and Playwright:

```sh
node build.mjs
node scripts/e2e.mjs http://127.0.0.1:12447 "<token>" .devhome-verifier/shots
```

`scripts/e2e.mjs` runs against any running DSH instance (pass its base URL and
`?token=` value). It needs `playwright` resolvable locally, or
`DSH_PLAYWRIGHT=/path/to/playwright`. `scripts/dev.mjs` is a maintainer
convenience that boots an isolated runtime: set `DSH_BIN` to the runtime entry
(a `.js` bin or a `dsh` executable) and `DSH_HOME_TEMPLATE` to a template home;
see [`docs/CONTRACT.md`](docs/CONTRACT.md).

The suite covers the checklist in [`docs/CONTRACT.md`](docs/CONTRACT.md):
toolbar placement, comment create/edit/delete/delete-all, highlights and markers,
list popover, independent window + composer, drag/resize/minimize, sidebar-row
hiding, reload persistence, light/dark themes, and console cleanliness.

- The comment marks themselves are **browser-local** until they are sent: they
  are not synchronized across devices or Harness instances, and clearing site
  data removes them. Once a message carries them, that text is part of the
  durable conversation like any other user message.
- If a send fails, the annotations stay pending so the next attempt carries
  them again.
- Side-chat sessions are real forked sessions in the local session store; the
  plugin hides their sidebar rows. If browser storage is cleared, previously
  created side sessions become visible again (they remain ordinary sessions).
- One side-chat window at a time; it reuses the fork created for the same
  selected quote. Minimizing collapses the conversation body, so an unsent
  side-composer draft is not preserved across minimize/restore.
- Window geometry is remembered per page, not across reloads.
- Annotations anchor to the rendered text. If a message is edited or a fork
  changes the quoted text, the highlight falls back to a context-based search
  and is skipped when the quote no longer exists.
